BE-100
BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Theft Deterrent System

Back Door Courtesy Switch

INSPECTION OF SWITCH
INSPECT SWITCH OPERATION
(a) Check that there is continuity between terminal 1 and ground when the switch is free.
(b) Check that there is no continuity between terminal 1 and ground when the switch pin is pushed.
If operation is not as specified, replace the switch.

Theft Deterrent Horn

INSPECTION OF HORN
INSPECT HORN OPERATION
(a) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 1 and the negative (—) lead to terminal 2.
(b) Check that the horn blows.
If operation is not as specified, replace the horn.
